reason: The claim asserts handleRepoMerge/Sync/CherryPick forward branch/commit to internal/repos.Merge/Sync/CherryPick 'with no format check', framed as an unresolved asymmetry because internal/repos/*.go was outside this lane's chunk. Reading internal/repos/ops.go resolves it: Merge (line 41) and Sync (line 101) both call ValidateBranch(ctx, branch, repoPath) before shell.Run, and CherryPick (line 25) calls ValidateCommit(ctx, commit, repoPath) before shell.Run — the validation the claim says is absent is present, just centralized in the repos package instead of duplicated in the HTTP handler (handleRepoCommits validates in the handler only because it needs the branch value for its own page data before calling repos.Commits, not because Merge/Sync/CherryPick skip validation). shell.Run also execs via exec.CommandContext with an argv slice (internal/shell/shell.go), never shell string interpolation, so there is no injection surface either way. The claim's premise is false, not merely unresolved.
